description: Fix the Post Job 'Something went wrong. Please try again.' failure. Harden createJob in jobs_provider.dart to send only columns confidently present on the quirky legacy campaigns table, deliver a new idempotent supabase/POST_JOB_FIX.sql that relaxes NOT-NULL/CHECK constraints and reloads PostgREST, and add a small clearly-marked temporary raw-error surface in post_job_screen.dart's failure SnackBar.
steps: Read lib/features/jobs/providers/jobs_provider.dart createJob() first. It currently INSERTs into public.campaigns: title, description, category, payout_per_creator, slots, deadline, cover_image, payout_model:'job', brand_id, brandName:'Rexo', status:'active', budget:0, created_at, updated_at.

Harden createJob: keep sending only columns we are confident exist and that the insert needs — title, description, category, payout_per_creator, slots, deadline, cover_image, payout_model:'job', brand_id, brandName:'Rexo', status:'active', created_at, updated_at, and budget as a valid number. Do NOT send createdAt (camelCase). Keep payout_model:'job' in the INSERT body (that is a value in the row, NOT a server-side filter — this is allowed; only .eq/.neq QUERIES on payout_model are forbidden). If a NOT NULL/CHECK on budget/escrow could reject 0, use a small safe positive value instead of 0 (e.g. budget: (data['payment_amount'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0 so it mirrors payout, or 1 if 0 is risky — choose a value the SQL CHECK will accept; document the choice in a code comment).
Do NOT reintroduce any server-side .eq('payout_model',...) or .neq('payout_model',...) query anywhere. Keep the existing client-side filtering approach in the providers untouched.

Add a brief code comment above the createJob insert explaining the column set is intentionally minimal to survive the legacy campaigns schema, and that POST_JOB_FIX.sql relaxes the remaining NOT-NULL/CHECK constraints.

Create NEW file supabase/POST_JOB_FIX.sql — idempotent, safe to re-run. Mirror the documentation/header style of supabase/FIX_PGRST205_permanent.sql (a HOW TO USE header comment). It must: (a) a DO block that loops over information_schema.columns for table_schema='public' AND table_name='campaigns' where is_nullable='NO' AND column_default IS NULL, and runs ALTER TABLE public.campaigns ALTER COLUMN <col> DROP NOT NULL for every such column EXCEPT the protected set id, title, description, brand_id, status; (b) drop or relax any CHECK constraint on public.campaigns that references payout_model / payoutModel / platform in a way that could reject 'job' or NULL — loop pg_constraint (contype='c') joined to pg_class for relname='campaigns', and DROP CONSTRAINT any whose pg_get_constraintdef mentions those column names; (c) ensure the status CHECK allows 'active' and 'closed' — drop any existing status check constraint and (optionally) recreate one that permits at least 'active','closed' (or leave status unconstrained); (d) end with NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema'; and NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload config';. Wrap DDL in DO $$ ... $$ blocks with EXECUTE format(...) and guard with IF EXISTS/exception handling so re-runs never error. Add clear comments.

Edit lib/features/admin/screens/post_job_screen.dart _save() failure branch: currently it calls _showError(ErrorUtils.sanitize(err.error) ...). Append the raw error for debugging: build the message as the sanitized text PLUS a newline and the raw e.toString() truncated to ~300 chars, e.g. "$sanitized\n[debug] ${raw.length > 300 ? raw.substring(0,300) : raw}". The raw error comes from ref.read(jobsActionsProvider).error (err.error). Mark the added debug lines with a // TODO(remove-debug) comment so it is clearly temporary. Keep the sanitized message first so normal UX is unchanged; only append debug when err.hasError.
Balance braces/parens in both edited Dart files. Do not change createJob's or _save's signatures.
acceptance_criteria: createJob sends a minimal confident column set (no createdAt), keeps payout_model:'job' as an insert VALUE (not a filter), brandName:'Rexo', status:'active', a valid numeric budget, created_at, updated_at; provider signature unchanged.
No .eq('payout_model'...) or .neq('payout_model'...) query exists anywhere under lib/.

supabase/POST_JOB_FIX.sql exists, is idempotent (safe to re-run), loops information_schema to DROP NOT NULL on all NOT-NULL-without-default campaigns columns except id/title/description/brand_id/status, drops/relaxes payout_model/payoutModel/platform CHECK constraints, ensures status allows 'active'/'closed', and ends with NOTIFY pgrst 'reload schema'.
post_job_screen.dart failure SnackBar appends the raw e.toString() truncated ~300 chars next to the sanitized message, marked // TODO(remove-debug).
Both edited Dart files have balanced braces/parens and unchanged public signatures.
verification: Read jobs_provider.dart createJob back; confirm column set and that createdAt is absent and no .eq/.neq payout_model query was introduced.
grep lib/ for .eq('payout_model' and .neq('payout_model' — must be zero matches.

Read supabase/POST_JOB_FIX.sql back; confirm DO block loops information_schema, excludes id/title/description/brand_id/status, drops payout_model/platform checks, and ends with NOTIFY pgrst 'reload schema'.
Read post_job_screen.dart _save() back; confirm the TODO(remove-debug) raw-error append is present and sanitized message still shows first.
Balance braces/parens in both Dart files.
findings: Implemented all three parts. (a) jobs_provider.dart createJob hardened: column set is minimal (title, description, category, payout_per_creator, slots, deadline, cover_image, payout_model:'job', brand_id, brandName:'Rexo', status:'active', budget, created_at, updated_at). budget now uses payout>0 ? payout : 1 (a valid positive number) instead of 0 to survive any budget CHECK/NOT-NULL constraint; documented in a code comment. No camelCase createdAt is sent (grep for createdAt returns zero). payout_model:'job' kept as an insert VALUE only; no .eq/.neq query filter introduced. Provider signature unchanged. (b) Created supabase/POST_JOB_FIX.sql — idempotent, mirrors FIX_PGRST205_permanent.sql HOW-TO-USE header style. Section A: DO block loops information_schema.columns for public.campaigns where is_nullable='NO' AND column_default IS NULL and DROP NOT NULL on each EXCEPT protected set (id,title,description,brand_id,status), with per-column exception handling. Section B: loops pg_constraint contype='c' on campaigns and DROPs any CHECK referencing payout_model/payoutModel/platform. Section C: drops any status-only CHECK and recreates campaigns_status_allowed_chk permitting active/closed (+draft/paused/completed/NULL). Section D: NOTIFY pgrst 'reload schema' and 'reload config'. Section E: verification queries as comments. (c) post_job_screen.dart _save failure branch appends raw err.error.toString() truncated to 300 chars after the sanitized message, guarded by err.hasError, marked // TODO(remove-debug); sanitized message still shown first. VERIFICATION: grep lib/ for .eq('payout_model'/.neq('payout_model') = 0 matches. Both Dart files brace/paren balanced via a string/comment-aware parser (all depths 0). Flutter/Dart not installed and network INTEGRATIONS_ONLY, so no flutter analyze/build/test run and the SQL was not executed against the live DB — the SQL is delivered for the user to run manually in the Supabase SQL editor per project convention.
